render_dict_as_tree: render a Python dictionary as a tree string using print_tree with unicode box-drawing characters
render_list_as_tree: render a Python list as a tree string using print_tree with default settings
render_named_tuple_as_tree: render a named tuple as a tree string showing field names and values via print_tree
render_tree_ascii: render a Python object as a tree string using ASCII characters by passing unicode=False to print_tree
render_tree_custom_children: render a Python object as a tree using a custom get_children function passed to print_tree
